blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present an AI assistant for automating anti-corruption expertise of draft legislation based on the TRACE architecture, designed to screen bills for corruption risks: pinpoint provisions an expert would criticise and name the regulatory defect in each. The pipeline combines a deterministic parsing core, model-guided single-provision qualification, rule-based factor assignment, and external human oversight. To evaluate the assistant, we constructed an open benchmark from the published conclusions of Ukraine's National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), comprising 132 draft laws with 474 model-extracted findings. A system flag agrees with a finding when it targets a compatible provision and an LLM judge rates the risk as the same (strict) or partly the same (lenient). On 100 draft laws, the pipeline matches 0.28 of the findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model, 0.30 with Sonnet 5.5, and 0.43-0.46 across all flags (non-blind; the frozen blind baseline achieves 0.21, 95% CI 0.16-0.26). Across all runs, most misses occur on provisions that the system located but qualified as a different risk, and none of the 32 legal-collision findings was matched. On 21 acts held out from tuning, the pipeline outperforms a monolithic prompt containing the full methodology under the strict measure, though not under the lenient one, and Opus 5.5 adds nothing over Sonnet. The reported scores reflect agreement with model-extracted findings rated by an LLM judge whose two access routes agree on 73 of 74 labels, without human expert validation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Anti-corruption expertise of draft acts is a statutory procedure in Ukraine carried out by the
National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK). Under the methodology approved by NAZK Order
No. 109/23 [ 1 ] , an expert identifies a provision that creates conditions for corruption,
assigns the corresponding corruption-risk factor from a 30-factor taxonomy, and recommends how to
remove it. NAZK conducts this review selectively for drafts submitted to the Verkhovna Rada and the
Cabinet of Ministers and publishes the resulting conclusions. Hundreds of public conclusions are already available, yet the incoming stream of drafts far exceeds what manual review can cover. A practical question follows: can an automated system indicate which provisions of a draft an expert should inspect first and what risk to look for in them?

blocks.en: Each stage of the pipeline maps directly onto a layer of the TRACE architecture [ 9 ] . The deterministic core L1 parses the draft and normalises provision addresses without calling a language model. In layer L2, classical BM25 retrieval (L2a) selects candidate provisions and relevant NAZK examples, while the language model (L2b) is invoked strictly to qualify one provision at a time through a structured schema, leaving the methodology factor to be derived by deterministic rules. Layer L3 ranks the resulting flags and optionally re-prioritises the top ten in a single call per act. Human supervision L4 remains outside the software boundary, where the NAZK specialist writes the official conclusion. This design directly tests TRACE’s principle of computational parsimony: whether a mid-size local model suffices once deterministic code handles document structure and taxonomy mapping. A similar decomposition was previously applied to an assistant for Supreme Court legal positions [ 10 ] , where two independent expert panels evaluated seven models. The present study provides a second legal instantiation of TRACE and the first evaluated against published conclusions of a state oversight agency. Here the architecture, the reasoning schema, and the amendment parser serve as experimental instruments; our focus is on the benchmark, the empirical measurements, and the analysis of failure modes.

blocks.en: 2 Anti-corruption expertise and related work
blocks.zh: 2个 反腐败专门知识和相关工作

blocks.en:
The Methodology of anti-corruption expertise approved by NAZK Order No. 109/23 of 18 May 2023 [ 1 ] replaced the agency’s earlier 2020 guide. It defines corruption-risk factors as
properties of a provision that create conditions for a corruption offence and pairs each factor with
standard recommendations for removing the defect. In a published NAZK conclusion, every finding is anchored to a specific
provision of the draft. Across the conclusions we collected, the text typically summarises the provision first, then introduces the regulatory defect and factor after a contrastive marker (such as “however” or “at the same time”), and closes with a
recommendation; Diorditsa et al. [11] describe the broader administrative procedure in detail. For evaluation design, a key property of a NAZK
conclusion is that it does not claim to exhaust every flaw in a bill, recording only the risks the agency judged material.

一、为腐败犯罪创造条件的条文的属性,以及
消除缺陷的标准建议。 在公布的NAZK结论中,每个发现都基于一个特定的
草案的规定。 在整个我们收集的结论中,案文通常首先概括这一条款,然后在对比性标记(例如“无论如何”或“同时”)之后提出监管缺陷和因素,然后以“同时”结尾。

blocks.en:
Earlier work on automating anti-corruption review approached the problem either through lexical heuristics or from a doctrinal perspective. Rakhvalova et al. [2] proposed detecting corruption-risk factors with
linguistic cues such as markers of discretionary power (“has the right”, “may”, “decides”),
evaluative adjectives, and missing deadlines. Looking at the institutional framework, Talapina [3] examined the legal
conditions for applying artificial intelligence to statutory and anti-corruption review, identifying draft legislation as the most suitable target. Neither study, however, tested how closely an automated system reproduces the actual conclusions of an expert agency. More broadly, research on machine learning in administrative law emphasises that advisory tools must leave the legal decision with the human official while making the tool’s own performance auditable [ 12 , 13 ] .

General benchmarks for legal language models cover a wide range of tasks, yet none targets statutory anti-corruption review. LegalBench [ 4 ] compiles diverse legal reasoning tasks, CUAD [ 7 ] and
LexGLUE [ 14 ] test contract extraction and classification, GreekBarBench [ 5 ] grades free-text bar-exam answers with an LLM judge, and UA-Legal-Bench [ 6 ] evaluates tasks drawn from Ukrainian court decisions. Among rule-checking datasets, the
closest analogue is the compliance review of national technical standards [ 15 ] . While grading open-ended legal explanations with
an LLM judge has become standard practice [ 16 ] , a judge model’s alignment with human specialists requires separate verification; our protocol measures only inter-route reproducibility for the same judge model ( Section 3.4 ).

blocks.en: Finally, evaluating an amending bill requires reconstructing how its instructions alter the statute in force. Automatic consolidation of statutes and extraction of amending commands have been studied across several jurisdictions [ 17 ] , including German [ 18 ] and Polish [ 19 ] statutory law, and our deterministic parser for Ukrainian amending bills builds on the same principles. Once a provision is isolated, we qualify it through schema-guided reasoning, prompts the model to populate fields sequentially from verbatim evidence to the specific risk category (an approach related to structured rule templates studied by Yang et al. [20] ). The closest end-to-end legislative task is Corazza et al. [8] , who use a hybrid AI pipeline to estimate whether a bill risks being held unconstitutional, though at the level of the bill rather than provision by provision against agency conclusions.

blocks.en: 3.1 Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.1 企业

blocks.en:
We assembled the digest of published anti-corruption expertise conclusions from the NAZK
portal, comprising 627 conclusions in total: 230 on draft laws, 391 on draft resolutions of the Cabinet of
Ministers, and 6 on other acts. Of these, 609 conclusions identify at least one corruption-risk factor, while the public feed contains no
conclusions reporting zero factors. For every conclusion on a draft law, we retrieved the corresponding bill text from the Verkhovna Rada portal in the edition active on the conclusion date.
This yielded 132 complete pairs with extracted findings ( Section 3.2 ), consisting of 131 draft laws and one resolution. The bills in the test split are born-digital
PDFs, whereas the 9 acts in the holdout split are scanned documents recognised with Tesseract, and 23 acts in test100
are scans transcribed for experimental purposes by Sonnet 5.5 rather than a production OCR pipeline.

blocks.en:
Because a NAZK conclusion is written as narrative prose, comparing it against system flags requires structuring each finding into a discrete record containing the provision address in the draft (e.g. “subpara. 4,
para. 15, Section I”), the methodology factor, a verbatim quote stating the risk, and the
agency’s recommendation. We used the model gpt-6.1-sol under a fixed instruction (prompt version gold-v1 ) to extract these records across all 132 pairs. Given the conclusion text and the
30-factor taxonomy, the model outputs one structured record per finding along with a confidence tag. Both the extraction script and the resulting records are included in the public release. Because these records were not manually curated, every entry in the dataset carries the status
“draft”. On the 21 acts of the test and holdout splits, an automated check that searched for the extracted quotes inside the bill texts surfaced six discrepancies:
three findings cited a pre-registration draft whose provisions had been dropped before formal registration and were therefore excluded, while three required address corrections where item numbering had shifted between versions. Removing the three obsolete entries leaves 474 evaluated findings out of 477. Throughout the paper, the term “NAZK findings” refers to these model-extracted records.

blocks.en: 3.4 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价协议

blocks.en: A system run produces an ordered list of flags, each specifying a provision address, a factor, a risk explanation, and a supporting quote. Evaluation proceeds in two stages: deterministic address matching followed by semantic risk comparison.
blocks.zh: 一个系统运行生成一个命令的旗帜列表,每个指定一个规定地址,一个因子,一个风险解释,和一个支持引用. 评价分两个阶段进行:确定地址比对,然后进行语义风险比较。

blocks.en:
A system flag is eligible to match a NAZK finding only if their normalized addresses are compatible (meaning they point to the exact same unit or one contains the other, after resolving superscript indices
Art. 28 1 = = Art. 28-1 and article spans “Articles 39–41”). Findings that have no address-compatible flag among the system’s top K K outputs are scored as missed immediately, without invoking the judge.
Whenever one or more compatible flags exist within the top K K , the judge model ( gpt-6.1-sol ; prompt in Appendix A ) receives the full text of the NAZK finding, its risk quote, and all address-compatible flags blinded to system identity.
For each candidate pair, the judge assigns one of three labels: same risk , partly the same (the flag targets the same provision and a related regulatory flaw, but states the defect too broadly or incompletely), or different . A finding is counted as reproduced if at least one of the first K K compatible flags achieves the required label. Because NAZK occasionally raises multiple distinct findings against a single long article, matching is many-to-many; the judge evaluates each finding independently, although a single overly broad flag rated partial against two findings on the same article can slightly inflate lenient recall.

blocks.en: We report two primary metrics at cut-off K = 10 K=10 : strict recall (“same”) and lenient recall (“same + partial”). For runs that emit long candidate lists, we also report recall over all emitted flags ( K = all K=\text{all} ) alongside the mean number of flags per act. Standard precision cannot be computed from public data because NAZK conclusions document only selected material risks rather than exhaustive annotations, so an unmatched system flag is not necessarily a false positive.

blocks.en: Confidence intervals (95 %) are obtained via cluster bootstrap resampling at the act level (5,000 replicates) to account for within-act correlation among findings. Pairwise system comparisons use a paired bootstrap over the same acts, accompanied by the win/loss count of acts where one system reproduces more findings than its comparator; differences whose 95 % confidence interval lies entirely above zero are typeset in bold. Finally, to verify that the judge itself is stable across API providers, we scored four Stage A runs independently through both Codex and OpenRouter. Across the 74 findings that triggered a judge call in both routes, the assigned three-way labels agreed in 73 cases ( Table 2 ), confirming high inter-route reproducibility.

blocks.en: 4 System under test
blocks.zh: 4 测试中系统

blocks.en: The evaluated pipeline decomposes anti-corruption screening into modular steps that can be inspected independently ( Fig. 1 ). Deterministic code isolates and addresses individual provisions, a language model qualifies one provision at a time, and deterministic rules map the resulting risk category onto the official NAZK taxonomy. This layout follows the four-layer TRACE architecture [ 9 ] , separating deterministic parsing (L1), retrieval and model inference (L2a/L2b), list-level orchestration (L3), and external human decision-making (L4).
blocks.zh: 经评估的管道将反腐败筛选分解为可独立检查的模块步骤(图1)。 定点码隔离并处理个别规定,一种语言模式每次限定一项规定,定点码规则将由此产生的风险类别映射到正式的NAZK分类。 这种布局遵循了四层TRACE架构[9],分离了定型解析(L1),检索和模型推论(L2a/L2b),列表级管弦(L3)和外部人类决策(L4).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Pipeline architecture under test. Language-model calls are restricted to single-provision qualification (L2b) and optional list-wise prioritisation (L3); all surrounding steps run in deterministic code. Solid boxes denote processing stages and dashed boxes denote data artefacts. The monolithic baseline replaces the entire pipeline with a single prompt containing the full methodology and bill text.
blocks.zh: 图 1:测试中的管道建筑. 语言模式调用仅限于单位提供资格(L2b)和可选的列表优先排序(L3);所有周围步骤均以定型码运行. 固体盒表示处理阶段,破损盒表示数据工艺品。 单一基准用一个包含完整方法和法案文本的单一提示取代整个管道。

blocks.en: In the deterministic layer ( L1 ), the parser segments the bill into structural units (article, part, paragraph, subparagraph, indent), assigns each unit a canonical address, and (for amending bills) links each item of the bill to the target provision of the law being amended. During the benchmark runs, the current and proposed wordings of amended provisions were extracted from the mandatory comparative table submitted alongside the bill. A separate consolidation module that applies amending commands (“restate”, “supplement”, “delete”, “replace”) directly to the base statute powers the interactive demonstration and the legislation knowledge base ( Section 6 ), but was not used in the scored runs. We denote the parser frozen for the blind runs as v1, and the version updated after error analysis on test100 (fixing merged unit boundaries, article spans, and single-item sections) as v1.1.
blocks.zh: 在确定层(L1)中,剖析器将法案分为结构单元(第1条,部分,第1款,缩进),为每个单元指定一个峡谷地址,(为修改法案)将法案的每个项目与正在修正的法律的目标条款联系起来。 在基准运行期间,从与法案一并提交的强制性比较表中摘录了修正条款的现有和拟议措辞。 一个单独的合并模块,将修改命令(“重报”、“补充”、“删除”、“替换”)直接适用于基准法规,授权互动示范和立法知识库(第6节),但在评分中并未使用。 我们表示对盲点运行的解析器冻结为v1,在测试100上错误分析后更新的版本(固定合并的单位边界,文章跨度和单项部分)为v1.1.

blocks.en: Candidate selection and example retrieval ( L2a ) filter the parsed units down to those containing a power-granting norm, risk-related vocabulary, or an amendment, capped at 40 units for new bills and 60 for amending bills. For every candidate unit, a BM25 search retrieves two historical precedents from a bank of 361 NAZK findings across 119 acts. To prevent data leakage, findings drawn from the bill under evaluation or from any earlier or parallel draft of the same bill (matched by registration number or title similarity) are strictly excluded.
blocks.zh: 候选人选择和实例检索(L2a)将解析的单元过滤到包含授予权力规范、与风险有关的词汇或修正的单元,新账单上限为40个单元,修改账单上限为60个单元。 对于每个候选单位,BM25搜索从一个361个NAZK调查结论的银行中检索到两个历史先例,涉及119项行为。 为防止数据泄露,严格排除了从正在评价的法案或同一法案的任何较早或平行的草案(登记号或所有权相似)中得出的结论。

blocks.en: During single-provision qualification ( L2b ), the language model receives one candidate unit (for amending bills, the amending clause paired with its comparative-table rows) together with the two retrieved NAZK examples. Rather than selecting a methodology factor directly, the model populates a structured reasoning schema ( Appendix A ) in fixed order: a verbatim evidence quote, the target provision, the norm’s addressee (public authority, private party, or both), any missing procedural safeguards (grounds, criteria, deadlines, procedure, decision form, appeal route, oversight, liability), one of eight high-level risk types, the affected anti-corruption mechanism, a concise statement of the risk, and a confidence level (evident or doubtful). Deterministic code in L3 then maps the chosen risk type and addressee onto the 30-factor NAZK taxonomy ( Table 7 ) and attaches the corresponding statutory recommendation from Section V of the methodology.
blocks.zh: 在单项规定资格(L2b)期间,语言模型接收一个候选单位(用于修改账单,修改条款与其比较表行对齐)以及两个检索到的NAZK实例. 模型不是直接选择方法因素,而是按固定顺序列出结构化推理计划(附录A):逐字记录、目标条款、规范的对象(公共当局、私人当事方或两者),任何缺失的程序保障(依据、标准、期限、程序、决定表、上诉路线、监督、责任),八种高风险类型之一,受影响的反腐败机制,风险的简明说明,以及信任程度(明显或可疑)。 L3中的定型代码然后将选定的风险类型和收件人映射到30要素NAZK分类(表7),并附上方法第五节的相应法定建议。

blocks.en: To produce the final output list, L3 first orders all flags by deterministic rules (placing evident findings ahead of doubtful ones, and breaking ties by confidence and BM25 similarity to NAZK precedents). Because L2b inspects provisions in isolation, this local ranking often diverges from what an expert considers most important across the whole bill, whereas a typical NAZK conclusion highlights only a handful of key defects (median 3 findings per act, interquartile range 2–5). When optional L3 prioritisation is enabled, the model makes one additional call per act: given the bill’s title and all generated flags, it promotes up to ten of the most material flags to the top of the list while retaining the remaining flags below them.
blocks.zh: 为了产生最终产出列表,L3首先通过定型规则订购所有旗帜(将明显的发现放在可疑结果之前,并以信任和BM25与NAZK先例相似的方式打破联系). 由于L2b单独检查条款,这种地方排名往往与专家认为在整个法案中最重要的内容不同,而典型的NAZK结论则只强调少数关键缺陷(中间每个行为3个调查结果,方位范围2-5). 当启用可选的 L3 优先级时, 该模式会在每个法案中追加一个调用: 考虑到法案的标题和所有生成的旗帜, 它将最多十种最重要的旗帜提升到列表的首位, 同时保留其下方的剩余旗帜.

blocks.en: As a baseline , we evaluate the monolithic single-prompt design from our initial prototype, which passes the system instructions, the complete text of the NAZK methodology, and the full bill text in one request (allowing up to 12,000 output tokens, with temperature set to 0 for reproducibility). Across all experiments, the local model profile uses Gemma 4 31B (served via OpenRouter at FP8 or higher precision) and the primary cloud profile uses Claude Sonnet 5.5 (low reasoning effort). On Stage A we also tested Claude Opus 5.5 under identical settings as an upper reference point. Each configuration was executed once; because Gemma exhibits minor run-to-run variance even at temperature 0, multi-run variance was not estimated.
blocks.zh: 作为基线,我们从我们最初的原型中评估单一的单瞬间设计,它传递了系统指令,NAZK方法的完整文本,以及一份请求中的法案全文(允许最多12,000个输出符,温度设定为0,以复制). 在所有实验中,局部模型剖面都使用Gemma 4 31B(通过OpenRouter在FP8或更高精度下服务),主云剖面使用Claude Sonnet 5.5(低推理努力). 在A阶段,我们还在相同的设置下测试了克劳德·奥普斯·5.5,作为最高参考点. 每个配置都执行过一次;因为Gemma即使在0温度下也会显示小的运行间差异,所以没有估计多运行差异.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Regarding the four pre-registered questions ( Table 3 ), our experiments yield the following outcomes. First, on the 21 blind acts, pipeline structure improves strict risk agreement over the monolithic prompt on the same local model, though the gain under the lenient measure does not clear the significance threshold ( Section 5.2 ). Second, on test100 (non-blind), list-wise L3 prioritisation narrows the gap between the local Gemma model and cloud Sonnet to within sampling noise ( Section 5.1 ). Third, for Sonnet, the structured pipeline reduces the average number of flags per act nearly fourfold while preserving recall ( Section 5.3 ). Fourth, across every evaluated run, the dominant failure mode consists of provisions that the pipeline successfully located but qualified as a different risk ( Section 5.4 ).
blocks.zh: 关于四个预先登记的问题(表3),我们的试验得出以下结果。 首先,关于21项盲动行为,管道结构改进了对同一地方模式上的单一提示的严格风险协议,尽管宽大措施下的收益并未明确意义门槛(第5.2节)。 第二,在测试100(非盲)上,列表式L3优先化将当地Gemma模型和云松网之间的距离缩小到取样噪声范围内(第5.1节). 第三,对于Sonnet来说,结构化管道在保留召回权的同时,将每次行为的旗帜平均数量减少了近四倍(第5.3节)。 第四,在每次评估的运行中,主要故障模式包括管道成功定位但符合不同风险条件的规定(第5.4节)。

blocks.en: 5.1 Performance on 100 draft laws
blocks.zh: 5.1 对100项法律草案的执行情况

blocks.en: On the 100 draft laws of test100 , the pipeline with L1 v1.1 and L3 prioritisation reproduces 0.28 of NAZK’s findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma model (95 % CI 0.23–0.33), compared with 0.30 using Sonnet (0.25–0.37). When all emitted flags are considered (averaging 22–26 flags per act), lenient recall reaches 0.43 for Gemma and 0.46 for Sonnet ( Table 4 ). Because L1 v1.1 incorporates parser repairs motivated by diagnostics on test100 , these figures represent an upper-bound, non-blind estimate. By contrast, the strictly blind run with the frozen v1 parser and Gemma achieves a top-10 lenient recall of 0.21 (0.16–0.26) across all 100 bills, and 0.19 (0.14–0.24) on the 88 bills not previously seen in Stage A. Evaluating the full untruncated flag list of that blind run raises recall to 0.36, indicating that top-10 truncation discards roughly two-fifths of the matched findings.
blocks.zh: 在100项测试法草案中,装有L1 v1.1和L3优先的管道使用当地Gemma模型(95% CI 0.23–0.33)在其前十旗内复制了NAZK的0.28结论,而使用Sonnet的则有0.30(0.25–0.37). 在考虑所有发射的旗帜时(每枚22-26枚旗帜),Gemma的宽大召回达到0.43枚,Sonnet的0.46枚(表4)。 由于L1 v1.1 包含基于测试100上的诊断的剖析器修复,这些数字代表了上行,非盲估计. 与此相对照的是,与冻结的v1 parser和Gemma的严格盲目运行在所有100个法案中实现了0.21(0.16–0.26)和0.19(0.14–0.24)的宽大召回,前者是以前在A阶段看到的88个法案。 对这次盲跑的全部未刷标记清单进行评估后,回想起0.36次,表明前10次截断大约是相应结果的五分之二。

blocks.en: Isolating the individual pipeline modifications under the lenient top-10 measure shows that the L1 v1.1 parser repairs alone add +0.03 (95 % CI − 0.01 -0.01 to + 0.06 +0.06 ), whereas adding L3 list-wise prioritisation on top of L1 v1.1 contributes +0.04 ( + 0.01 +0.01 to + 0.07 +0.07 ; improving 18 acts and hurting 5). Without L3 prioritisation, Sonnet outperforms Gemma by +0.07 ( + 0.03 +0.03 to + 0.11 +0.11 ). Once L3 prioritisation is enabled for Gemma, that gap narrows to +0.03 ( − 0.02 -0.02 to + 0.07 +0.07 ), satisfying our second registered criterion, albeit on non-blind data and without proving formal statistical equivalence.

blocks.en: 5.2 Structured pipeline versus monolithic prompt on blind acts
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 结构化输油管与盲行为时的单体触发

blocks.en: On the 21 blind acts of Stage A ( test and holdout pooled), decomposing the task into a pipeline sharpens how the local model qualifies corruption risks without expanding the set of provisions it reaches. Within the pipeline, Gemma 4 31B reproduces 0.13 of NAZK’s findings under the strict measure (95 % CI 0.05–0.24), whereas the same model driven by the monolithic prompt scores 0.00 (winning on 7 acts and losing on 0; Table 5 ). Under the lenient measure, the paired gain is +0.11 ( − 0.05 -0.05 to + 0.31 +0.31 ); because the confidence interval crosses zero, the first pre-registered criterion ( Table 3 ) is not met. Inspection of the outputs shows that the monolithic prompt locates several of the same articles and hints at a related concern (0.20 lenient recall), but its explanations remain too generic to match the specific regulatory defect identified by NAZK.
blocks.zh: 在A阶段的21个盲目行为(试验和搁置)中,将任务分解成一个管道,使当地模式在不扩大它所达到的一套规定的情况下如何定性腐败风险。 在管道中,Gemma 4 31B在严格计量(95% CI 0.05–0.24)下复制了NAZK的0.13项调查结果,而同一模型则由单质的即时得分0.00(7次行为得分,0次损失;表5)驱动。 在宽大度措施下,配对收益为+0.11(−0.05-0.05至+0.31+0.31);因为置信间隔跨过0,不符合第一个预先登记的标准(表3). 对产出的检查表明,单体即刻将一些相同的文章和暗示放在一个相关的关切上(0.20宽大回顾),但其解释过于笼统,无法与NAZK查明的具体监管缺陷相匹配。

blocks.en: Swapping the local model for a stronger cloud model inside the same pipeline raises strict recall from 0.13 (Gemma) to 0.23 (Sonnet 5.5), a paired gain of +0.11 ( + 0.01 +0.01 to + 0.21 +0.21 ). Scaling further to Opus 5.5, however, brings no benefit: scored through the same OpenRouter judge route (marked ‡ in Table 5 ), Opus trails Sonnet by − 0.09 -0.09 under the lenient measure ( − 0.17 -0.17 to 0.00 0.00 ) despite emitting a nearly identical number of flags per act (10.4 vs. 11.1). Performance also drops across all systems on the 9 holdout acts, which consist of Tesseract-recognised scans dominated by three long amending bills that account for 20 of the split’s 29 findings.

blocks.en: 5.3 Effect of structure on a frontier cloud model
blocks.zh: 5.3 结构对前沿云模型的影响

blocks.en: When paired with a capable cloud model (Sonnet 5.5), the primary benefit of the pipeline is output selectivity rather than raw recall. Evaluated over all emitted flags on the 12 test acts, the pipeline achieves 0.63 lenient recall compared with 0.74 for the monolithic prompt (paired difference − 0.11 -0.11 , 95 % CI − 0.26 -0.26 to + 0.13 +0.13 ), while cutting the average volume of flags per bill from 30.1 down to 7.9 ( Table 5 ). Although this meets our third pre-registered criterion, the 12-act sample size makes the finding preliminary.
blocks.zh: 当与有能力的云模型(Sonnet 5.5)配对时,管道的主要好处是输出选择性而不是原始召回. 经过对12项试验行为中所有发射的旗帜进行评估,管道实现了0.63次宽放召回,而单体速率为0.74次(差幅为−0.11-0.11,95%为CI−0.26-0.26至+0.13+0.13),同时将每张账单的平均旗帜数量从30.1降至7.9(表5)。 虽然这符合我们第三个预先注册的标准, 但12个样本的大小是初步的。

blocks.en: 5.4 Stage-by-stage loss diagnosis
blocks.zh: 5.4 分阶段损失诊断

blocks.en: Breaking down missed findings by pipeline stage reveals where the performance ceiling originates ( Fig. 2 , Table 6 ). Across all five analysed runs, the single largest loss bucket is “location found, risk different”, accounting for 38 % of all misses in the blind test100 run and up to 64 % for Sonnet on holdout , thereby confirming our fourth criterion. Summing the categories in Table 6 shows that the pipeline successfully surfaces the provision criticised by NAZK for 72–86 % of all benchmark findings (combining reproduced findings, provisions flagged with a different risk, flags ranked below the top-10 cut-off, and candidates that L2b declined to flag). By contrast, L1 parsing failures (where a unit or its address was not properly segmented) account for 10–26 % of the findings depending on the split and parser version.
blocks.zh: 按编审阶段分列遗漏的调查结果,可以发现性能上限的来源(图2,表6)。 在经过分析的五个运行中,最大的损失桶是“找到位置,风险不同”,占盲目测试100运行中全部失利的38%,对Sonnet来说高达64%,从而确认了我们的第四个标准。 汇总表6中的类别显示,管道成功浮出NAZK批评的供给占所有基准结果的72-86%(合并了重复的调查结果,标注了不同风险的规定,旗帜排在前10位的截止点以下,候选人L2b拒绝挂旗)。 相比之下,L1解析失败(如果一个单位或其地址没有适当划分)占结果的10-26%,取决于拆分和解析版本.

blocks.en: Examining recall by methodology factor ( Table 8 in Appendix B ) points to the specific domain knowledge that single-provision qualification lacks. Most strikingly, the pipeline failed to reproduce any of the 43 legal-collision findings (factor F-III-09) in the benchmark, scoring 0/32 on test100 and 0/5 on Stage A. Identifying a normative collision requires knowing the external statute with which the draft conflicts, information that is absent when the model inspects a single provision in isolation. For the two most prevalent factors, discretionary powers without criteria (F-III-01) and vague regulation of rights and duties (F-III-06), the blind test100 run matches 34 of 133 (26 %) and 21 of 108 (19 %) findings under the lenient measure. Qualitative inspection of holdout errors illustrates why many address-matched flags are rated different : where NAZK pinpoints a concrete statutory flaw (such as duplicate grounds for dismissal, an open-ended list of valid reasons for non-appearance, or a missing notification deadline), the model often falls back on a generic complaint about unspecified administrative procedure.
blocks.zh: 按方法因素审查召回情况(附录B表8),说明缺乏单一规定资格的特定领域知识。 最令人吃惊的是,该管道未能在基准中转载43项法律汇编结论中的任何一项(要素F-III-09),在测试100上得分为0/32,在A阶段得分为0/5。 确定规范性的碰撞需要了解与草案发生冲突的外部法规,当模型单独检查单一条款时,所缺少的信息。 对于两个最普遍的因素,即没有标准的自由裁量权(F-III-01)和对权利和义务的模糊规定(F-III-06),盲目测试100在宽大措施下与133项(26%)和108项(19%)结论中的21项(34项)匹配。 对拒服兵役错误的定性检查说明了为什么许多地址匹配的旗帜被评为不同的:如果NAZK指明具体的法定缺陷(如解雇理由重复、不公开的有效理由清单或通知截止日期缺失),该模式往往落后于对未具体说明的行政程序的一般投诉。

blocks.en: 6 The corruption-risk dial: placing a provision in temporal context
blocks.zh: 6个 腐败风险拨号:将一项条款置于时间背景中

blocks.en: As shown in Section 5.4 , most misses occur when the pipeline locates the provision criticised by NAZK but assigns a different risk, while collisions with external statutes go entirely undetected. Qualifying a provision in isolation deprives the reviewer of context that human experts routinely consult: how often the target article has been amended, which earlier bills attempted to modify it, and what corruption risks NAZK identified in those earlier bills. The corruption-risk dial is an exploratory visual interface designed to surface this historical record alongside the pipeline’s flags. It performs no additional language-model calls and generates no new risk scores; instead, it projects the pipeline’s output onto the bitemporal legislation knowledge base.
blocks.zh: 如第5.4节所示,大多数缺失发生在管道找到受到NAZK批评但分配不同风险的条款时,而与外部法规的碰撞则完全未被发现。 单枪匹马地限定一项条款,剥夺了审查者通常征求人类专家意见的背景:目标条款在多大程度上得到修正,先前的法案试图修改,以及早先的法案中查明的NAZK有哪些腐败风险。 腐败风险拨号是一个探索性的视觉界面,旨在将这一历史记录与管道旗一并显示。 它没有进行额外的语言模式调用,也没有产生新的风险分数;相反,它将管道的产出投射到时间立法知识库中。

blocks.en: In the dial view ( Fig. 3 ), the bill under review sits at the centre of the circle, surrounded by nodes representing the articles of statutes in force that the bill amends. A node’s angular position encodes the date of the article’s most recent edition prior to the analysis date, placing recently modified articles near the “analysis date” hand. Radial distance reflects priority: articles carrying top-ranked flags appear closer to the centre, whereas unflagged articles sit on the outer rim. Node colour indicates the highest severity among the article’s flags, and node size scales with flag count. Along the outer ring, red diamonds mark earlier draft laws that touched the same articles, positioned at the dates of their respective NAZK conclusions. Clicking an article node opens an inspection panel showing the pipeline’s flags with verbatim quotes, the article’s version history, the earlier bills and NAZK findings linked to that article, and incoming cross-references from other articles of the same statute. A time slider lets the user inspect the state of the corpus as of any historical date.
blocks.zh: 在拨号视图(图3)中,所审查的法案坐落在圆形的中心,周围是代表法案修正的生效法规条款的节点. 一个节点的角位置在分析日期之前编码了文章最新版本的日期,将最近修改的文章放在“分析日期”手附近。 辐射距离反映优先级:带有顶级旗帜的文章看起来更接近中心,而未悬挂标记的文章则坐落在外侧. 节点颜色表示文章的旗帜中最高的重度, 以及带有旗帜计数的节点大小尺度 。 在外环一带,红钻石在早先触及相同条款的法律草案上留下了标记,这些法律草案位于各自的NAZK结论之日。 点击文章节点,打开一个检查小组,显示管道的旗帜,并附有逐字记录、文章的版本历史、早先的账单和与文章有关的NAZK调查结果,以及来自同一章程其他条款的相互参照。 时间滑动器允许用户检查任何历史日期的本体状态.

blocks.en: The underlying knowledge base stores statutes as hierarchical trees of provisions (article, part, item, indent) across all dated editions, linked to draft bills through the L1 amendment map ( Section 4 ). Statutory texts and edition histories are ingested from the official Verkhovna Rada legislation portal, and expertise conclusions come from the NAZK website. In its current state, the knowledge base indexes 253 primary legislative acts and 132 draft bills with NAZK conclusions; L1 successfully linked at least one amendment to a stored statute for 87 of those bills, identifying 293 articles that were modified by two or more drafts.
blocks.zh: 基础知识库通过L1修正图(第4节)与法案草案挂钩,在所有日期的版本中将法规作为条款的分级结构(条款、部分、项目、缩进)。 官方最高拉达立法门户的法规文本和版本历史被吸收,专门知识结论来自NAZK网站. 目前,知识库将253项主要立法法案和132项法案草案与NAZK结论联系起来;L1成功地将其中87项法案中至少一项法规修正案联系起来,确定了经两项或更多草案修改的293项条款。

blocks.en: To prevent temporal leakage during retrospective evaluation, the interface enforces strict filtering rules: only drafts whose NAZK conclusion predates the analysis date are displayed on the outer ring, and the bill under review is always excluded so the user never sees NAZK’s actual conclusion for the target bill. Flags whose evidence quote cannot be verified in the provision text are suppressed. Cross-bill links are resolved at the article level because finer-grained overlaps at the part or item level are sparse. At present, the knowledge base captures 13,117 internal cross-references within individual statutes but does not yet index cross-references between distinct laws, meaning inter-statutory collisions remain invisible. Similarly, the dial is largely empty when a bill introduces an entirely new statute or amends an act not yet in the base. Among the 100 bills in test100 , 35 share at least one amended article with an earlier bill that has a prior NAZK conclusion.
blocks.zh: 为了防止回溯性评价中的时间渗漏,界面执行严格的过滤规则:只有NAZK结论在分析日期之前的草稿才会显示在外环上,所审查的帐单总是被排除在外,因此用户从未看到NAZK对目标帐单的实际结论. 在条款文本中无法核实证据引文的旗帜被压制。 交叉单链接在文章层面得到解决,因为部分或项目层面的细纹重叠很少。 目前,知识库在个别法规中收集了13 117个内部相互参照,但尚未对不同法律之间的相互参照进行索引,即法定碰撞仍然看不见。 同样,当法案提出全新的法规或修改一项尚未在基部的法令时,拨号基本上空空。 在100个法案中,有35个法案至少与先前有NAZK结论的法案一起修正了一条。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Our experiments show that decomposing anti-corruption review into a structured pipeline helps a mid-size local model identify the exact regulatory defect named by NAZK (raising strict recall on blind acts from 0.00 to 0.13), even though the monolithic prompt already touches many of the same provisions under the lenient measure. Across all configurations, the primary bottleneck lies in risk qualification rather than structural parsing or raw model scale: the pipeline reaches the target provision for 72–86 % of the benchmark findings, scaling from Sonnet 5.5 to Opus 5.5 yields no improvement, and the largest share of misses consistently stems from provisions flagged with a different risk category. Moreover, single-provision qualification is blind to inter-statutory collisions. Addressing these two failure modes points to two concrete engineering extensions: supplying the qualification step with external statutory context from the legislation knowledge base ( Section 6 ), and replacing the single generic qualification prompt with targeted diagnostic checks for specific defect patterns (such as missing deadlines, open-ended lists, unrestricted data access, or normative collisions).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,将反腐败审查分解成一个结构化的管道,有助于一个中等规模的当地模式确定NAZK命名的准确监管缺陷(从0.00到0.13),尽管单一的提示已经在宽大措施下触及了许多相同的规定。 在所有配置中,主要的瓶颈在于风险资格,而不是结构分析或原始模型规模:管道达到了基准结果的72-86%的目标规定,从Sonnet 5.5到Opus 5.5的缩放没有产生任何改善,最大的缺失部分始终来自不同风险类别的规定。 此外,单一条款限制对法定碰撞视而不见。 解决这两种失败模式需要两个具体的工程扩展:从立法知识库(第6节)中提供外部法定背景的资质步骤,以及用针对具体缺陷模式(如缺失的最后期限、无限制清单、不受限制的数据获取或规范性碰撞)的定向诊断检查来取代单一的通用资质。

blocks.en: From a deployment standpoint, the system is designed as an analytical triage aid that highlights candidate provisions and supporting quotes for initial expert inspection, while final legal qualification and conclusions remain with the human specialist.
blocks.zh: 从部署的角度来看,该系统是作为分析分门别类的辅助工具设计的,它突出了供初步专家检查之用的候选条款和支持引文,而最后的法律资格和结论仍由人类专家负责。

blocks.en: 7.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7.1 限制

blocks.en: Both the benchmark records (provision address, factor, risk quote) and the semantic match labels were produced by language models ( gpt-6.1-sol ) without human expert auditing, aside from six automated quote-verification corrections on the 21 Stage A acts. Extraction errors in the reference set can affect both the recall denominator and address matching, while any systematic leniency or strictness in the judge model shifts absolute recall levels across all systems (though paired differences between systems scored by the same judge are less affected). Although two independent API routes to the judge agreed on 73 of 74 labels, inter-route stability measures reproducibility rather than alignment with human legal experts.
blocks.zh: 基准记录(提供地址、因数、风险引号)和语义匹配标签都是由语言模型(gpt-6.1-sol)制作的,没有经过人类专家审计,另外还有关于21阶段A行为的6个自动引号验证更正。 参考数据集中的提取错误既会影响召回分母,也会影响地址匹配,而法官模型中的任何系统性宽大或严格性会改变所有系统的绝对召回水平(尽管同一法官得分的系统之间的配对差异受影响较小)。 虽然两条独立的API通往法官的路线就74个标签中的73个达成一致,但路线间稳定性措施是可复制的,而不是与人类法律专家保持一致.

blocks.en: Because NAZK publishes no “zero-factor” conclusions and records only selected material defects in each bill, public data cannot establish whether an unmatched system flag is a false positive or a valid risk that NAZK chose not to include. Consequently, the benchmark measures recall of published agency findings rather than precision.
blocks.zh: 由于NAZK没有发表"零因子"结论,只记录每张账单中选定的重大缺陷,公共数据无法确定一个未匹配的系统旗是假阳性还是NAZK选择不包含的有效风险. 因此,基准衡量标准回顾已公布的机构调查结果,而不是精确。

blocks.en: The strictly blind comparison between the pipeline and the monolithic prompt rests on 21 Stage A acts (56 findings), resulting in wide confidence intervals. Because all 132 draft-law pairs in the corpus are already assigned to splits, no further blind sample of draft laws remains, though 391 published conclusions on Cabinet of Ministers resolutions offer a separate out-of-distribution reserve. In addition, each experimental configuration was run once despite minor output variance in Gemma at temperature 0, and OCR errors on scanned bills (9 Tesseract-recognised acts in holdout and 23 model-transcribed acts in test100 , where superscript indices such as Art. 69 1 are occasionally flattened to “69”) account for part of the L1 address losses.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We have introduced an open benchmark for evaluating automated anti-corruption review of draft legislation against published conclusions of Ukraine’s National Agency on Corruption Prevention (NAZK), paired with an address-gated LLM-judge protocol. On 100 draft laws, a layered pipeline built on the TRACE architecture reproduces 0.28 of NAZK’s findings within its top ten flags using the local Gemma 4 31B model and 0.30 using cloud Sonnet 5.5 (non-blind upper bounds, versus 0.21 in the strictly blind run). On 21 blind acts, decomposing the task into deterministic parsing, single-provision qualification, and rule-based factor mapping enables the local model to match NAZK’s specific risk category significantly more often than a monolithic prompt, without increasing the number of reached provisions.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了一个开放的基准,用以对照乌克兰国家预防腐败局公布的结论,评价立法草案的自动反腐败审查,并配以地址标定的LLM法官协议。 在100部法案中,一个基于TRACE架构的分层管道使用当地的Gemma 4 31B模型在其前十旗内复制了NAZK的发现的0.28,使用云索内5.5(非盲上界,相对于严格盲跑中的0.21)的0.30. 在21个盲目行为中,将任务分解为决定性的解析、单一提供条件和基于规则的因子映射,使得当地的模型比单一的提示更经常地匹配NAZK的特定风险类别,而不会增加达到的规定的数量。

blocks.en: These findings align with the architectural premises of TRACE while clarifying what remains to be solved. Restricting the language model to single-provision reasoning allows a 31B local model to approach cloud-model recall once list-wise prioritisation is added, while scaling further to Opus 5.5 yields no gain on blind acts; these single-run results are consistent with computational parsimony. Crucially, the current performance ceiling is imposed by missing statutory context rather than model capacity: inspecting provisions in isolation cannot detect normative collisions with external laws. Within the TRACE framework, the natural next step is to couple single-provision qualification with the bitemporal legislation knowledge base (mirroring how our earlier Supreme Court assistant grounded model calls in an index of legal positions [ 10 ] ) and to expose that historical context to the human reviewer through the corruption-risk dial ( Section 6 ). Before any system can be certified for operational use, however, two validation steps are essential: auditing the model-extracted reference findings and calibrating the LLM judge against human anti-corruption specialists.
blocks.zh: 这些结论符合TRACE的建筑设计,同时澄清了有待解决的问题。 将语言模型限制为单备推理,允许31B本地模型在添加列表优先排序后处理云模型召回,而进一步缩放到Opus 5.5则对盲行为不产生收益;这些单备结果与计算解析一致. 关键是,目前的业绩上限是由缺失的法定背景而不是模型能力强加的:孤立检查条款无法发现规范与外部法律的碰撞。 在TRACE框架内,下一个自然步骤是将单一规定资格与时空立法知识库结合起来(模仿我们之前的最高法院助理基于模型在法律立场索引中如何呼唤[10]),并通过腐败风险拨号向人审者揭露这一历史背景(第6节)。 然而,在对任何系统进行业务使用认证之前,两个验证步骤至关重要:审计模型提取的参考结论和校准LLM法官与人类反腐败专家的对比。

blocks.en: 9 Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 9. 道德考虑

blocks.en: Because both the reference findings and the evaluation labels in this study were generated by language models without human verification, the reported recall figures serve strictly to compare alternative pipeline designs on a shared benchmark. They must not be cited as certified accuracy rates for detecting corruption risks in legislation.
blocks.zh: 由于本研究的参考结论和评价标签都是由语言模型生成而未经人类验证,因此所报告的召回数字严格地用于比较共同基准的替代管道设计. 在立法中发现腐败风险时,不得将其作为经认证的准确率。

blocks.en: Anti-corruption expertise carries direct institutional consequences for draft legislation and its sponsors. While the evaluated pipeline surfaces a substantial share of text-internal risks, it does not replace expert analysis of broader statutory context and inter-law relationships; its output is therefore designed as a prioritised triage list of candidate provisions backed by verbatim quotes. In line with the TRACE architecture, the official assessment remains entirely with the human expert, and relying on the system’s flags without specialist review or treating an empty flag list as automatic clearance runs counter to its intended design.
blocks.zh: 反腐败专门知识对立法草案及其提案国具有直接的体制影响。 虽然经评价的管道呈现出相当一部分文本-内部风险,但它并不取代专家对更广泛的法定背景和法律间关系的分析;因此,其产出被设计为一份有逐字记录支持的候选条款优先分类清单。 根据TRACE架构,官方评估仍完全由人类专家负责,依靠系统的旗帜而不经过专家审查,或将空的旗帜清单视为自动清除不符合其预期设计。

blocks.en: All corpus materials come from public official sources (published NAZK conclusions and draft bills registered on the Verkhovna Rada portal) and contain no personal data beyond the names of public officials acting in their official capacity. Because these public documents predate model training cut-offs, pretraining contamination cannot be ruled out and may contribute to measured recall. Finally, as disclosed under Competing interests, the authors are involved in preparing a pilot proposal for an anti-corruption expertise assistant for NAZK; the agency did not participate in or endorse this study, and all benchmark data, cached judge decisions, and evaluation scripts are released for independent verification.
blocks.zh: 所有实体材料都来自官方来源(已公布的NAZK结论和在最高拉达门户网站上登记的法案草案),除了以官方身份行事的公职人员的姓名之外,没有任何个人资料。 由于这些公共文件在示范培训截止日期之前就已经终止,因此不能排除训练前的污染,而且可能有助于衡量召回。 最后,正如在竞争利益下披露的那样,作者参与为NAZK编写反腐败专家助理的试点建议;该机构没有参加或赞同这项研究,所有基准数据、缓存法官决定和评价脚本都公布,供独立核查。
